strategy_description: 5日均线上穿20日均线买入，下穿卖出。标的:平安银行(000001.XSHE)
strategy_content:
import pandas as pd

# 获取20个交易日的日K线数据
k_data = get_price(pro_code, '1d', count=20)

if len(k_data) < 20:
    keep['signal_buy'] = False
    keep['signal_sell'] = False
else:
    closes = k_data['close'].values
    MA5 = closes[-5:].mean()
    MA20 = closes.mean()
    current_price = closes[-1]
    
    # 买入信号：当前价 > MA5 > MA20（均线多头排列）
    keep['signal_buy'] = bool(current_price > MA5 and MA5 > MA20)
    
    # 卖出信号：当前价 < MA5 或 MA5 < MA20（均线空头排列）
    keep['signal_sell'] = bool(current_price < MA5 or MA5 < MA20)
    
    # 记录数值供分析
    keep['MA5'] = float(f'{MA5:.2f}')
    keep['MA20'] = float(f'{MA20:.2f}')
    keep['price'] = float(f'{current_price:.2f}')
    
    print(f'[{date}] Price={current_price:.2f} MA5={MA5:.2f} MA20={MA20:.2f} Buy={keep["signal_buy"]} Sell={keep["signal_sell"]}')
strategy_describe: 本策略是经典的均线交叉趋势跟踪策略。当价格站在MA5之上且MA5在MA20之上时买入（金叉形态）；当价格跌破MA5或MA5跌破MA20时清仓卖出（死叉形态）。标的为平安银行(000001.XSHE)，每次买入使用95%可用资金，回测周期为2023年度。
